BlackClaw RWA Advisor v1.0.0

- Initial release of a multi-jurisdictional Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization advisory skill.
- Provides regulatory structuring, token classification, compliance architecture, and issuance strategy guidance across UAE, EU, US, Singapore, Hong Kong, KSA, Pakistan, and more.
- Supports jurisdictional analysis, regulatory frameworks, and Sharia-compliant token design.
- Covers regimes such as UAE’s VARA/ADGM/DIFC, EU’s MiCA, US SEC/CFTC, Singapore MAS, Hong Kong SFC/HKMA, Saudi CMA/SAMA/REGA, and Pakistan’s Virtual Assets Act.
